name: Handstand
description: Full inversion balancing on the hands with the body vertical.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Face a wall and put your hands down shoulder-width apart, a hand's length from it.
Come into Downward-Facing Dog and walk your feet a little closer.

keyframes.name: Downward-Facing Dog
keyframes.cue: Press the hips up and back into an upside-down V.

keyframes.name: Handstand
keyframes.cue: Kick up and stack the hips and feet over the hands.
